title: Mapper-continuity scarp traces (hypothesis H79-A with H79-E folded in)
registered_before: reading any HOLDOUT-DTI of this lane (experiment 1 launched 22:05:10Z; file written while it ran)
single_method_lane: terrain-only scarp likelihood (1 m lidar cache + 10 m 3DEP + 100 m det_elev) x line-continuity (Sato tubularity) -> 3-px dots; no geophysics, no catalogue feature, no prior-submission raster as feature
hidden_truth_model: lidar-visible scarps traced by experts; new geometry of known systems counts (organizer-confirmed)

holdout.masking: visible catalogue masked pixel-exactly; withheld whole components are the truth; features catalogue-free
holdout.ci: paired percentile bootstrap over 20 km blocks, 1000 draws, seed 520810 (pooled_summary)

arms.C1_pixel: HGB scarp likelihood p, dots by rank (lane baseline)
arms.C2_continuity: S = sqrt(p * Sato01(p)), dots by rank (PRIMARY)
arms.C3_continuity_q: C2 with the uniqueness quota (<= 66 % of dots inside the 3-px halo of the H19-5 line set); the shipped construction
arms.REF_h19_5_redot: static H19-5 line set re-dotted fold-fair (label-aware; reference only)

shipped_budget_rule: anchored to the live-validated operating point of the champion (37,654 dots, 2.8 px spacing, > 2 px from catalogue); the holdout budget optimum is reported but does NOT override the anchor unless it is lower (holdout truth is catalogue-like and over-rewards dense emission, cf. H85 0.19 holdout vs no live confirmation)
gates_to_promote: no single feature with symmetric canary AUC > 0.90 on withheld positives
C3 pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > C0_random with paired 95 % CI excluding 0
C3 pooled HOLDOUT-DTI >= C1_pixel - 0.005 (continuity must not hurt) on seed 30 AND seed 20
registry audit: Spearman <= 0.90 vs every raster; <= 70 % of dots within 3 px of any discriminating prior (like-for-like, IR-H85-01), literal reading reported too
validator: finite, in [0,1] everywhere inside the footprint, zero catalogue mass, CRS/shape/transform identical to sample_submission
what_would_falsify: C2 <= C1 on both seeds (continuity adds nothing) or C3 within CI of random (off-halo evidence is noise)
experiment_budget: max 3 experiments / 2 h wall clock; this file counts experiment 1 = seed-30 run, experiment 2 = seed-20 confirmation, experiment 3 = reserved for one fix if a gate fails
no_selection: this project does not choose which submission occupies a leaderboard slot
